verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents its own export path: you can download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, which gives a portable, inspectable copy of model content. That covers only page-level export of the Model, with nothing on exporting the whole account. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export of all data (models, connected-source actuals, changelog, chats), CSV/JSON or other open-format exports beyond per-Page Excel, an offboarding/data-portability statement, and independent corroboration.
